sub: The access you have given applications through GNAP, each grant with what it allows and the tokens the application holds under it. Revoking takes effect at once: every token issued under the grant stops working, the application cannot renew it or ask anything more of it, and it has to ask you afresh.
cellsNote: The grants this cell holds. A grant is made where its client arrives and moves to its resource owner's home cell before it is approved, so this is normally all of them; a grant whose client instance is registered in another cell stays there and is listed and revoked there.
none: You have given no application access through GNAP. When one asks and you allow it, the grant appears here.
ended: {reason, select, issued {finished: its tokens were issued and it can no longer be changed} revoked {revoked} rejected {refused} expired {expired} other {{reason}}}
subjectReleased: It was also told who you are, {when}.
tokenStateValue: {state, select, live {live} rotated {rotated} revoked {revoked} expired {expired} other {{state}}}
noTokens: No token was issued under it.
grantedRenewable: Granted {when}; it can be renewed until {until}.
doneRevoked: Revoked: {name} no longer has the access you gave it. It asks you again next time.
